content_en.title: Savings & Loan Cooperative Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a savings and loan cooperative with three offices. Visitors compare savings and deposit rates, estimate loan installments and apply online with the right documents; members track balances and installments, and account officers review each application in one place.
content_en.challenge:
The old site opened with a slogan slider and a 'Learn more' button. The savings rate appeared as 5% on the homepage but 3.5% on the product page, and loan installments were spread across five long tables of around seventy rows, with a separate calculator that only offered a tenor dropdown.

The online application asked for a collateral type and nothing else, so applicants did not know which documents to prepare. Important fraud warnings (no unsecured loans, no upfront fees) sat in a long text block, every photo carried a domain watermark, and member feedback repeatedly asked for a way to check balances and installments online.
content_en.solution:
The homepage leads with an installment estimate, followed by a strip of product rates, a clickable time-deposit rate table that shows interest after tax, the loan ceiling tiers condensed into four rows, and the three accepted collateral types. Fraud warnings appear as a top banner and a dedicated block, next to the four application steps and the official offices and channels.

The loan screen splits simulation and application: amount, tenor and the full installment schedule update as the user types, while the form adjusts the document checklist to the chosen collateral. Members see savings, deposits, the savings-lottery account and their loan progress with the next installment and its virtual account. Account officers work from a review desk with document checks, repayment ratio, collateral value and survey notes before sending a case to the credit committee. The planned production stack is Laravel with MySQL, connected to the cooperative's core system.
features: Quick installment estimate with tenors limited by loan ceiling
Clickable time-deposit rate table with after-tax interest
Loan simulation with a full installment schedule
Online application with a document checklist per collateral type
Fraud warning banner and official channel list
Member portal for savings, deposits, savings lottery and loans
Account officer review desk with ratio and collateral checks

content_id.title: Website Koperasi Simpan Pinjam
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk koperasi simpan pinjam dengan tiga kantor. Pengunjung membandingkan bunga tabungan dan simpanan berjangka, menghitung angsuran, lalu mengajukan pinjaman online dengan dokumen yang tepat; anggota memantau saldo dan angsuran, dan account officer meninjau setiap pengajuan di satu layar.
content_id.challenge:
Situs lama dibuka dengan slider slogan dan tombol 'Learn more'. Bunga tabungan tertulis 5% di beranda tetapi 3,5% di halaman produk, dan angsuran pinjaman tersebar di lima tabel panjang berisi sekitar tujuh puluh baris, dengan kalkulator terpisah yang hanya menyediakan pilihan tenor.

Form pengajuan online hanya menanyakan jenis jaminan, sehingga pemohon tidak tahu dokumen apa yang perlu disiapkan. Peringatan penipuan yang penting (tidak ada KTA, tidak ada biaya di muka) berada di blok teks panjang, semua foto berwatermark domain, dan masukan anggota berulang kali meminta cara mengecek saldo dan angsuran secara online.
content_id.solution:
Beranda dibuka dengan perkiraan angsuran, diikuti strip bunga produk, tabel bunga simpanan berjangka yang bisa diklik dan menampilkan bunga setelah pajak, tingkatan plafon pinjaman yang diringkas jadi empat baris, dan tiga jenis jaminan. Peringatan penipuan tampil sebagai pita di atas header dan blok tersendiri, di samping empat langkah pengajuan serta kantor dan saluran resmi.

Layar pinjaman membagi simulasi dan pengajuan: nominal, tenor, dan jadwal angsuran lengkap berubah saat diketik, sementara form menyesuaikan checklist dokumen dengan jaminan yang dipilih. Anggota melihat tabungan, simpanan berjangka, tabungan arisan, serta progres pinjaman dengan angsuran berikutnya dan virtual account-nya. Account officer bekerja dari meja tinjauan berisi cek dokumen, rasio angsuran, nilai jaminan, dan catatan survei sebelum meneruskan kasus ke komite kredit. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Laravel dengan MySQL, terhubung ke core system koperasi.
features: Perkiraan angsuran cepat dengan tenor sesuai plafon
Tabel bunga simpanan berjangka interaktif dengan bunga setelah pajak
Simulasi pinjaman dengan jadwal angsuran lengkap
Pengajuan online dengan checklist dokumen per jenis jaminan
Pita peringatan penipuan dan daftar saluran resmi
Portal anggota untuk tabungan, berjangka, arisan, dan pinjaman
Meja tinjauan account officer dengan cek rasio dan jaminan
